students = [
    ("Tanaka", [78, 85, 94]),
    ("Suzuki", [88, 74, 82]),
    ("Yamada", [65, 90, 71]),
    ("Ito", [80, 79, 85]),
    ("Kato", [92, 88, 95]),
    ("Mori", [70, 62, 78]),
]
records = sorted(
    ((name, sum(scores)) for name, scores in students),
    key=lambda row: (-row[1], row[0]),
)
previous = None
rank = 0
for index, (name, total) in enumerate(records, 1):
    if total != previous:
        rank = index
    average = total / 3
    print(f"{rank}. {name} total={total} average={average:.2f}")
    previous = total
